newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil little changed in dull market.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil little changed in dull market.

text.p: NWE gas oil was little changed on Friday as sinking premiums cancelled out the effects of moderate futures gains in a fairly dull end-of-the-week market, traders said.
July IPE settled 25 cents higher at $162.75 a tonne.
Heating oil barges were under pressure with premiums assessed at July IPE -25 cents/+25 cents fob ARA.
The market was fairly quiet in dull Friday trade and as players worked out the implications of the 136,000 tonnes gas oil delivery into the June contract.
Low sulphur diesel material was still in the doldrums with premiums approaching record lows.

Some traders speculated that local refiners would try and scale down low sulphur production although others said the high level of imports at the moment would cancel out the price supportive nature of such a move.
Cargoes were fairly quiet with Russian material quoted around July IPE flat/+50 cents for first second half June delivery.
Lwo sulphur cargoes were quoted around July IPE +$5.00/+$6.00 cif NWE.
